accepted.reason: pass -> fail. Fits GATE-A1 (FALSE PASS): the old test equalled its reference only because both lost their page size. Chrome prints test AND reference at 540 x 432 pt (7.5in x 6in, the tentative @page width/height descriptors). Old vellora printed both at 360 x 216 pt (the 5in x 3in UA box): its @page reader did not strip the CSS comment in front of the test's `size: 1234px`, so it read the property name '/* ... */ size' and dropped the declaration; the reference has no size. Now comments are stripped and the test gets `size: 1234px` (925.5 x 925.5 pt, CSS Paged Media 3), the reference keeps 360 x 216; vellora does not implement the tentative width/height descriptors (follow-up).

acceptedRegressions.label: wpt-false-pass
acceptedRegressions.reason: pass -> fail. Fits GATE-A1 (FALSE PASS): the old test equalled its reference only because both lost their page size. Chrome prints test AND reference at 540 x 432 pt (7.5in x 6in, the tentative @page width/height descriptors). Old vellora printed both at 360 x 216 pt (the 5in x 3in UA box): its @page reader did not strip the CSS comment in front of the test's `size: 1234px`, so it read the property name '/* ... */ size' and dropped the declaration; the reference has no size. Now comments are stripped and the test gets `size: 1234px` (925.5 x 925.5 pt, CSS Paged Media 3), the reference keeps 360 x 216; vellora does not implement the tentative width/height descriptors (follow-up).
